name: Mavy
title: mavex.ai
shortDescription: Mavy acts as an AI executive assistant specializing in smart scheduling. It integrates with your email to manage appointments by simply being added to CC. Users can set up their working hours, and Mavy handles all the scheduling details, including the back-and-forth of emails. Ideal for busy professionals, it streamlines the process of organizing meetings without additional software. Example: CC Mavy in an email to schedule a meeting effortlessly.
pros: Automates scheduling by handling email communications
Integrates seamlessly with Gmail and Microsoft accounts
cons: Dependent on email usage for functionality
May not handle complex scheduling scenarios
Limited to Gmail and Microsoft email platforms
